_comment: Single source of truth for host permissions. Edit, then run: npm run sync-hosts (rewrites extension/manifest.json matches and extension/config.json dwHosts). Hostnames only in 'patterns' are fetch-only (no content script). A host may appear in both dw and patterns (editor site that also hosts the static pattern file). No <all_urls>. 'hook' lists AI hosts that get the page-world hook (content/ai-hook.js) at document_start.
